static_reference.note: Track geometry, corners, markers, layout sections, section percentages and map images are common to the event. Source folder names are provenance only.
static_reference.selection_rule: Each family is selected independently from the first source file that yields valid records, searching folders Race > Qualifying > Sprint > Practice 3 > 2 > 1.

layout_identity.note: Source layout metadata is preserved but does not by itself prove that coordinates match the intended current-season layout.

images.note: Image assets are retained for display. WebP red annotation components may be exported as image-space candidates only; no track-distance or corner anchor is inferred.

straight_mode_map_annotations.coordinate_space: source WebP image pixels; origin at top-left

geometry.coordinate_reference: source-local; x/y axes, origin, direction and coordinate transform not verified
geometry.units: unknown; raw source units retained without scaling

layout_section_metadata.note: Only arrays sharing one length are paired. Arrays of a different length (e.g. 'Section') are preserved raw and are not matched to section rows by index.

active_aero_zones.distance_semantics: Only structured source offsets paired with a corner anchor belong here. Absolute lap distances are not calculated by this processor.
active_aero_zones.map_annotation_note: Separate visual evidence; image coordinates are not activation offsets and are not telemetry-aligned.

session_model_inputs.precedence: Race, then Qualifying, then Sprint, then Practice 3/2/1. Lower-priority sessions are retained, not discarded.
